Question: Tom, Dick, and Harry started out on a \(100\)-mile journey. Tom and Harry went by automobile at the rate of \(25\) mph, while Dick walked at the rate of \(5\) mph. After a certain distance, Harry got off and walked on at \(5\) mph, while Tom went back for Dick and got him to the destination at the same time that Harry arrived. The number of hours required for the trip was:
